Six friends P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. P sits second to the right of U. R sits third to the right of Q. S and R both are the immediate neighbours of P. Who sits between Q and U?
questions.solution:
Six friends **P, Q, R, S, T and U** are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. R sits third to the right of Q.

2. S and R both are the immediate neighbours of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d35e0109da1a4c5e3ba01a1bb3fc9e6239b18ee7fc2e5c8ea1aa823f191811c.png] 

3. P sits second to the right of U.

The above condition cannot be satisfied in Case I, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/752c47a96e9a513f49b5e56b0f4528132af45769b51defdf4215686ea9dfd6e8.png] 

Clearly, T the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ded5b6f3f5288866c3f7d4ac6e426c670c2fb73b68943f6cb727dedac2aa8a2.png] 

Clearly, T sits between Q and U.

Hence, '**U**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Seven people, E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting in a straight row, facing north. H is sitting fourth to the left of I. K is sitting third to the left of F. J is sitting third to the right of F. G is sitting fourth to the right of K. Who sits at the third position from the left end of the row?
questions.solution:
Seven people, **E, F, G, H, I, J and K** are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1. K is sitting third to the left of F.

2. J is sitting third to the right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2ca20d2e2f829eabebf76405535b703c79513c1a1742fb05a83fc8f5bf47c3a.png] 

3. G is sitting fourth to the right of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1712863f3e68dee73a7283373a19f9b831a77e3485bb79009ae716d9af0a315.png] 

4. H is sitting fourth to the left of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0136e532c78c1903d6907fe5112c101efe746560c4ae6352566ae2deb5c061f4.png] 

E, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/775a7aa377c8a1c688b1a09e37436a1ad14acadd9e1f037232baabfa436f1b90.png] 

Clearly, E sits at the third position from the left end of the row.

Hence, '**E**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

4 ∶ 96 ∶∶ 13 ∶ ? ∶∶ 9 ∶ 161
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **(First number)² + 80 = Second number

 
• 4 ∶ 96 → 4² + 80 = 16 + 80 = 96
 
• 9 ∶ 161 → 92 + 80 = 81 + 80 = 161

Similarly,

 
• 13 ∶ ? → 132 + 80 = 169 + 80 = 249

Hence, '**249**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

 

(Words should be treated as meaningful words and should not be related to each other on the basis of number of syllables/number of consonants/number of vowels in the word)

 

Hen : Chick :: Butterfly : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **Second is the young one of the first.

 
• Hen : Chick → The young one of a hen is known as a chick.

Similarly,

 
• Butterfly : ? → The baby form of a butterfly is called a worm.

Hence, '**Worm**' is the correct answer.
